brief: An internal Accounting workspace that connects team tasks and workload, SAP asset-to-equipment mapping, cost analytics, and an auditable import trail.
criteria: A single memorable mark that works in monochrome, remains clear at browser-tab size, and feels at home in a premium enterprise workspace.

concepts.name: Trace Loop
concepts.idea: A clear loop leaves a visible point of provenance.
rationale: The open loop signals traceable work without drawing a literal ledger.
The separate point gives the mark a distinct entry cue at small sizes.
Indigo and Teal match the approved workspace direction; a mint point preserves contrast in reverse.

recommendation: Trace Loop is the selected direction. The two-colour master is the default on light backgrounds; use the reversed lockup on Midnight Indigo.
next_steps: Use the horizontal lockup in web headers and the symbol-only cut in compact contexts.
Confirm print colour on a physical proof before production.
